description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for setting up and managing display components using DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) APIs. It includes functions to initialize display resources such as encoders, connectors, CRTCs, and planes, as well as cleanup and property retrieval functions related to display control.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Initializes the encoder in the kms_ctx structure by selecting an appropriate encoder associated with a connector and possible CRTCs.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Finds and assigns the first connected display connector from the resource list to the kms_ctx structure.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Sets up the CRTC (Display Controller) for the given encoder in the kms_ctx structure.

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the kms_ctx structure, setting up resources, connector, encoder, and CRTC.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Frees all allocated resources within kms_ctx including connector, encoder, CRTC, and resources.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves a property ID by name for a given DRM object, searching through its properties.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Enumerates available display planes, identifying primary and overlay planes, and storing their IDs in kms_ctx.
